title: PR-030 is void per incuriam: the companion duplicate
subject: registry-hygiene-duplicates
ratio: PR-030 is void per incuriam on the same grounds PR-032 states for PR-031: it duplicates the Westphalia KPI doctrine already held by PR-029, the controlling authority it overlooked, and the T-368 spec ledger never authorized it. PR-029 remains the sole active record of that doctrine.
dicta: This record exists as a separate act only because of a control-plane defect discovered while publishing PR-032: --voids is not an accumulating flag, unlike --dicta, --sources and --tier-evidence on the same subcommand, so a publish carrying two --voids targets silently kept the last and discarded the first, exiting 0 with no warning that an explicit instruction had been dropped. PR-032's own relations array records one relation where two were requested. A control-plane tool that silently discards an instruction is a correctness defect of the same family as a false-green test run; it is filed for repair as T-376 and the inconsistent flag semantics are named there.
scope_conditions: duplicate or unauthorized records in the precedent registry
revisit_trigger: Revisit when T-376 makes --voids accumulate or makes a dropped instruction a refusal.
validity_conditions: the registry remains append-only; --voids accepts a single target per publish until T-376 lands
